MOD_WF_CONFLICT_TITLE: Worker Folks: Hiring is switched off
MOD_WF_CONFLICT_TEXT:
The mod ${mod} is loaded, and the two mods change the same mechanic: which skill the game treats as active and what keeps running when you start another one. ${mod} lets your character run every skill at once; Worker Folks lets hired Folks hold skills beside your own action. Loaded together they would fight over the active action and break skill timers, so Worker Folks has disabled itself for this session.

To use Worker Folks, disable ${mod} in the Mod Manager and reload. Nothing in your save was changed.

MOD_WF_TIP_1: Wages come out of the Payroll Reserve first, then your bank. Fill it before you leave the crew alone for a long time.
MOD_WF_TIP_2: An unpaid Folk keeps working for 15 min of work (30 min from its mastery 25) before it strikes. Put money back in time and the debt is collected on its next action.
MOD_WF_TIP_3: Switch the Worker box back to You: the Folk keeps going until you start an action on that page yourself.
MOD_WF_TIP_4: Only as many Folks work at once as you have Shift Slots. Buy more in the Shop; your highest Licence caps them.
MOD_WF_TIP_5: A fresh Folk earns 40% of its tier wage and gets raises with mastery, up to the full wage at 99. Firing clears the slot's mastery.
MOD_WF_TIP_6: A Folk on a strong money-maker pays for itself with some to spare; on anything else it runs at a loss.
MOD_WF_TIP_7: A Folk works with its own gear only, never yours. Press Gear on its card; equip requirements use your own levels.
MOD_WF_TIP_8: A thieving Folk takes the NPC’s hits and eats your selected combat food below 60% HP. Keep food equipped: a Folk at zero HP dies and its slot stays frozen for 24 h.
MOD_WF_TIP_9: Settling costs the owed wages plus a severance of 5% of your next hire’s price. Then the Folk cools down. Pay three times the severance to skip the cooldown.
MOD_WF_TIP_10: Folks work offline like your own action. The Welcome Back window lists what each Folk did and who went into debt or on strike.
MOD_WF_TIP_11: Mod Settings → Worker Folks: Hiring → Wage difficulty goes from No sweat (free labour, no strikes) to Evil hardcore (×5).
MOD_WF_TIP_12: The reserve holds this many hours of the whole crew’s wages:
